description: This file defines a React functional component for a login page, handling user email input, organization selection, password entry, and authentication flow. It includes state management, API calls for user organizations and login, UI styling, and navigation handling.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching user organizations based on provided email, updates state, and advances to credentials step.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login, including salt validation, calling login API, managing responses and navigation after login.
